name: pluginpool
description: Ten focused Claude Code plugins for everyday developer productivity. Deterministic Python helpers wrapped as slash commands — 89 hermetic tests, stdlib only at runtime.

plugins.name: commit-narrator
plugins.description: Generate conventional commit messages from staged diffs, including the *why*.

plugins.name: pr-storyteller
plugins.description: Generate PR title, body, and test plan from commits and diff vs base branch.

plugins.name: test-gap
plugins.description: Find lines in your diff lacking test coverage (Cobertura / lcov / coverage.json).

plugins.name: deps-doctor
plugins.description: Multi-ecosystem dependency audit (npm, pip, cargo, go) — one unified report.

plugins.name: env-lint
plugins.description: Compare .env vs .env.example key parity — never prints values.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Pre-commit secret scanner using pattern and entropy detection, with redacted output.

plugins.name: standup-gen
plugins.description: Generate daily standup notes from git activity across one or many repos.

plugins.name: todo-harvest
plugins.description: Scan for TODO/FIXME/HACK comments with git blame author and age.

plugins.name: flaky-detector
plugins.description: Run a test command N times and report per-test flakiness percentage.

plugins.name: changelog-forge
plugins.description: Convert conventional commits into a CHANGELOG section with a semver bump suggestion.
